newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu will have talks with the main opposition parties regarding the Romanian- Ukrainian treaty.
* The government meets in a session expected to debate several bills, state radio said, without elaborating.
* The upper house of parliament, the Senate, continues debates on the bill regarding the teachers' status. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
